Name: Stats reconcile type/market totals, include retiring bots and exclude private accounts
Inspection and formatting are deterministic and do not mutate the exchange
Reports use refresh P&L baselines instead of counting historical profit or funding
Depleted equity, pending exits, working and queued orders are counted accurately
Empty populations format without division by zero
Exact stats parsing and server ownership prevent unauthorized report generation
Group-owner reports are private and unavailable worlds fail closed
Stats failures do not block a later refresh or leak internal error details
